吸奶器.title: Momcozy Mobile Flow™ Hands-Free Breast Pump | M9
吸奶器.body_html:
What It Is
The Momcozy Mobile Flow™ Hands-Free Breast Pump M9 is a wearable, hands-free breast pump designed to help breastfeeding mothers express milk more conveniently and efficiently. Its compact, cordless design fits discreetly inside a nursing bra, allowing moms to pump while working, caring for their baby, commuting, or managing daily tasks.
Key Features
The M9 is equipped with an advanced third-generation motor that delivers strong and consistent suction to support efficient milk expression. Through the Momcozy app, users can personalize pumping modes and suction levels based on their comfort preferences and pumping needs. The DoubleFit™ flange design helps create a secure seal for improved comfort and fit, while the leak-resistant, all-in-one structure enhances portability and freedom of movement. A full charge provides approximately 4–5 pumping sessions, making it suitable for busy schedules.
Material & Feel
The milk-contact components are made from BPA-free, food-grade silicone that is soft, flexible, and gentle on sensitive skin. The lightweight wearable design provides a comfortable fit for extended wear while helping reduce pressure during pumping sessions.
Who It's For / Best Used For
The M9 is ideal for breastfeeding mothers who want a more flexible and discreet pumping experience. It is especially suitable for working moms, multitasking parents, travelers, and anyone who needs to express milk without being tied to a traditional pump setup. It can be used at home, in the office, while traveling, or during everyday activities.
Size / Compatibility
The wearable pump is designed to fit comfortably inside most nursing bras and is compatible with Momcozy wearable pumping accessories. Multiple flange size options are available to help mothers find a more personalized fit.
Care Instructions
Wash all milk-contact parts thoroughly after each use using warm water and mild detergent. Sterilize components regularly according to the user manual instructions. Ensure all parts are completely dry before reassembly and storage.

婴儿监控器.body_html:
• Product Type

    The BM01 is a classic, highly dependable momcozy monitor. Operating as a secure and stress-free baby monitor no wifi, it cuts through the technological clutter to give you instant, closed-loop peace of mind.

  • Core Selling Points

    As an exceptional, practical non wifi baby monitor, this unit utilizes a 2.4GHz FHSS wireless connection, meaning it forms a closed-loop system that no internet hacker can access. The 5-inch large display features a convenient split-screen function to take care of 2 babies or 2 different scenes simultaneously. The high-definition 1080P camera provides a movie-like viewing experience with a 360° field of view that automatically cycles between views to fully cover the baby's environment. Equipped with clear infrared night vision, it allows you to observe your baby all night long in the dark. Backed by a powerful 5000mAh battery, it keeps guarding for up to 11.5 hours even with frequent checks.

  • Material & Touch

    Manufactured from RoHS-certified, lightweight, paint-free injection molded plastic that is entirely odor-free. Every edge is meticulously polished into smooth, rounded curves, ensuring a comfortable, feather-light grip.

  • Target Audience / Use Case

    The ideal baby registry gift for expecting mothers and new parents who want an easy, app-free setup to watch over babies, pets, or the elderly with 100% privacy.

  • Size & Compatibility

    Features a compact, space-saving 5-inch display parent unit that fits easily on a nightstand or kitchen counter. The camera features full 360-degree panning capabilities.

  • Care Instructions

    Avoid using the device in highly humid or dusty environments. Gently clean the charging port with a dry cotton swab if dust accumulates. Periodically cycle the battery to optimize its lifespan.

婴儿监控器.body_html:
• Product Type

    The momcozy baby monitor bm04 is a high-performance momcozy 5 inch dual mode smart baby monitor with 2 camera system. Featuring a premium 1080P camera, it serves as an advanced video baby monitor that bridges the gap between private local viewing and convenient remote monitoring.

  • Core Selling Points

    As a top-tier momcozy dual baby monitor, it allows you to choose between a secure 2.4GHz local connection via the parent unit or a WiFi baby monitor feed via the app when you are on the go. This baby monitor with camera features intelligent AI motion detection that alerts you to risks like a covered face or face-down sleeping, alongside Danger Zone alerts. It supports continuous or motion-activated auto-recording to capture memories, which can be shared with up to 20 family members. Its powerful infrared night vision provides sufficient lighting to see your baby's face clearly in the dark when placed within 5 meters of the crib.

  • Material & Touch

    The camera and monitor housings are crafted from premium, matte ABS material with a skin-like finish that resists scratches and fingerprints. The parent unit is equipped with soft-touch silicone buttons designed for completely silent operation during late-night checks.

  • Target Audience / Use Case

    Perfect for tech-savvy parents, multi-child families requiring dual-room viewings, and working parents who want to stay securely connected with their little ones through a smart app.

  • Size & Compatibility

    Features a brilliant 5-inch parent display paired with two 1080P HD cameras. Ensure the camera is mounted at least 0.6m (24 inches) above the crib for optimal focal length, and within 5m (16 feet) horizontally for the best night vision performance.

  • Care Instructions

    Disconnect from power before cleaning. Wipe gently with a dry, lint-free microfiber cloth. Do not use chemical solvents or abrasive cleaners on the screen or camera lenses.

婴儿监控器.body_html:
The Momcozy 5.5 Inch Full HD Smart Non-WiFi Baby Monitor is a video baby monitor designed for parents who want clear, private, and smarter baby viewing without relying on home WiFi. It includes a dedicated parent unit and a 1080P Full HD baby monitor camera, giving families a secure local connection for everyday nursery check-ins, naps, and overnight monitoring.

 

BM03 Black combines a 5.5 inch Full HD screen, 1080P camera clarity, and a secure FHSS local connection with smart viewing features that make monitoring easier. Auto face focus helps keep your baby’s face easier to see on screen, while 360° pan, 140° tilt, and up to 4x zoom let you adjust the view as your baby moves. Smart sound, motion, cry, cough, and safe-zone notifications help parents notice meaningful changes without constantly watching the screen. Night view, two-way audio, and ENC noise reduction support clearer check-ins day and night.

 

The monitor and camera are made with smooth, durable plastic housing, softly rounded edges, and a clean matte finish. The parent unit feels comfortable to hold, with tactile physical buttons for quick control and a large screen that is easy to read during late-night use.

 

BM03 Black is ideal for parents who want a smart non-WiFi baby monitor, families who prefer a private local connection, and caregivers who need reliable room-to-room monitoring without opening an app. It supports multi-camera viewing and split-screen use, making it suitable for one nursery, siblings, or different rooms in the home.

 

For care, wipe the monitor and camera with a soft, dry cloth. Keep the device away from water, avoid harsh cleaners, and place the camera on a stable surface with a clear view of the baby’s sleep area. Storage card is not included.
